_comment: What an engine release installs, besides the locks. scripts/lock-engine.sh, build-engine-release.sh and engine-requirements.py read this; tests check engine/pyproject.toml and the locks agree with it.

moonshine._macWheels: PyPI has no moonshine-voice wheel for Intel Macs, and its Apple silicon one needs macOS 15. The Engine wheels workflow builds both for macOS 13.4 and publishes them as this release; the checksums come from its notes.

mlx._packages: The faster engine on Apple silicon (macOS 14+): Kokoro on the GPU through MLX. misaki needs spaCy's English model, which isn't on PyPI.
